title: Education and Career Guidance curriculum time in secondary schools
asked: Mr Shawn Loh asked whether the four hours per year of curriculum time for Education and Career Guidance in secondary schools can be increased, with support from external vendors, so that young Singaporeans can start dreaming of possibilities earlier in life.
response: The Ministry of Education recognises the importance of guiding students to develop awareness of their strengths and interests and explore education and career pathways at each stage. ECG curriculum time is complemented by student development experiences beyond the classroom, such as visits to institutes of higher learning, career fairs, talks, learning journeys and job-shadowing. The MySkillsFuture Student Portal is available from Primary 5, tertiary students have the MySkillsFuture Workforce Portal, and ECG counsellors are available from secondary schools and pre-university institutions. In a supplementary reply, Ms Jasmin Lau said ECG is not a competition between subjects, and that curriculum time allocation will continue to be reviewed, especially in the age of artificial intelligence where human skills are increasingly important.
